chapter: Chicago in the 1920s: Bix, Armstrong, Morton
title: Working with Louis Armstrong in 1928, then the Regal Theater and Earl Hines
summary: After Oliver left for New York, Howard played about eighteen months with Armstrong, then the Regal Theater, then Earl Hines.
